from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import replace
from typing import assert_type
from bazi.bazi import Bazi, LocationTime
from bazi.bazi_chart import BaziChart
from bazi.calendar.dates import GanzhiYearMonth, JieqiTime, LunarYearInfo
from bazi.calendar.hko_data import LunarYearInfo as HkoInfo
from bazi.calendar.hko_data.decoder import LunarYearInfo as DecoderInfo
from bazi.calendar.celestial_data.loader import LunarYearInfo as CelestialInfo
from bazi.defines import Zhu, TianganLayer, Dizhi, Jieqi, Tiangan, Ganzhi
from bazi.transits import TransitKind, TransitSet
from bazi.transit_chart import TransitChart
from bazi.analyzer.relationship import KongwangHit, KongwangResult, StarAppearance
from bazi.school import BaziConfig
from bazi.cli import main as cli_main
from bazi.common import frozendict
from bazi.knowledge import DEFAULT_SOURCE_PATH, KnowledgeBase, KnowledgeObject, KnowledgeEntry, KnowledgeSource, object_id, guoyin_entry, guoyin_def
from bazi.rules import ShenshaRules
from bazi.context_matching import NatalObservation, LiunianObservation, TransitObservation, Observation, YearCoordinate, MonthCoordinate, DateCoordinate, MomentCoordinate, LiunianPosition, ChartOccurrence, CriterionResult, CriterionReason, ContextResult, CriterionInfo, criterion, criteria, evaluate_context
chart: BaziChart = BaziChart(Bazi.create(datetime(2000, 1, 1, 12), "male"))
cli_exit: int = cli_main(["--help"])
transits = TransitChart(chart)
year_transits: TransitSet | None = transits.at_year(2024)
month_transits: TransitSet | None = transits.at_month(2024, Dizhi.辰)
date_transits: TransitSet | None = transits.at_date(datetime(2024, 4, 10).date())
moment_transits: TransitSet | None = transits.at_moment(datetime(2024, 4, 10, 12))
knowledge = KnowledgeBase.load()
entries: tuple[KnowledgeEntry, ...] = knowledge.query(object_id="tiangan.ding")
entry = entries[0]
display_flag: bool = entry.show_by_default
objects: tuple[KnowledgeObject, ...] = knowledge.find_objects("丁")
found: tuple[KnowledgeEntry, ...] = knowledge.search("丁", include_reference_only=True)
topics: tuple[str, ...] = knowledge.filter_values("topic")
catalog: frozendict[str, CriterionInfo] = criteria()
info: CriterionInfo = criterion("editorial.guansha_coexistence.v1")
observation_types: tuple[type[NatalObservation] | type[LiunianObservation] | type[TransitObservation], ...] = info.observation_types
source_path: Path = DEFAULT_SOURCE_PATH
identifier: str = object_id(Tiangan.丁)
guoyin = assert_type(guoyin_entry(knowledge, ShenshaRules.GuoyinDef.MODERN), KnowledgeEntry)
guoyin_definition = assert_type(guoyin_def(knowledge, guoyin.claim_id), ShenshaRules.GuoyinDef | None)
witness: KnowledgeSource = knowledge.sources["repository_guoyin_variants"]
display: str = knowledge.render(entries[0], show_sources=True, manual_context=True, premise_verdict="UNKNOWN")
subject_text: str = knowledge.render_subject(identifier, include_reference_only=True, show_sources=True)
matched: ContextResult = evaluate_context(chart, criterion_id="editorial.guansha_coexistence.v1", observation=NatalObservation())
result_input: Bazi = matched.bazi
copied: ContextResult = replace(matched, _bazi=result_input)
ids: tuple[str, ...] = matched.reference_ids
constructed: ContextResult = ContextResult(observation=matched.observation, criterion=matched.criterion, evidence=matched.evidence, reference_ids=ids, _bazi=result_input, knowledge=knowledge)
year_request = YearCoordinate(ganzhi_year=2024)
month_request = MonthCoordinate(ganzhi_year=2024, ganzhi_month=Dizhi.辰)
date_request = DateCoordinate(datetime(2024, 4, 10).date())
moment_request = MomentCoordinate(datetime(2024, 4, 10, 12))
observation: Observation = TransitObservation((TransitKind.LIUNIAN,), year_request)
liunian_observation = LiunianObservation(2024)
position = LiunianPosition(2024)
reason: CriterionReason = "premise_satisfied"
verdict = CriterionResult(info.criterion_id, reason, frozendict({}))
target = Ganzhi.from_str("甲子")
hit = KongwangHit(Zhu.月, target)
anchor = KongwangResult(Zhu.日, target, ())
appearance = StarAppearance(Zhu.月, target, TianganLayer.明干, Tiangan.甲)
lunar: LunarYearInfo = {"first_solar_day": datetime(2000, 2, 5).date(), "leap": False, "leap_month": None, "days_counts": [30] * 12, "ganzhi": target}
hko: HkoInfo = lunar
decoder: DecoderInfo = hko
celestial: CelestialInfo = decoder
local: Bazi = Bazi.create(datetime(2023, 12, 31, 22, tzinfo=UTC), "female", BaziConfig.from_values(precision="minute"), longitude=-157.4, civil_timezone=timezone(timedelta(hours=14)))
local_chart: BaziChart = BaziChart(local)
local_record: ContextResult = evaluate_context(local_chart, criterion_id="editorial.guansha_coexistence.v1", observation=NatalObservation())
coordinate: GanzhiYearMonth = local.ganzhi_year_month
from_branch: GanzhiYearMonth = GanzhiYearMonth.from_dizhi(2000, Dizhi.寅)
from_jie: GanzhiYearMonth = GanzhiYearMonth.from_jie(JieqiTime(Jieqi.立春, datetime(2000, 2, 4)))
reference: datetime = local.reference_datetime
month_jies: tuple[JieqiTime, JieqiTime] = local.month_jies
facts: LocationTime | None = local.location_time
if facts is not None:
  instant: datetime = facts.canonical_instant
  civil: datetime = facts.civil_time
  apparent: datetime = facts.apparent_time
